name: NeRF-based Trajectory Optimization
aliases: Differential Flatness-based Trajectory Optimization with NeRF
definition: A trajectory optimization method that uses a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) to compute collision-free paths by optimizing waypoint locations, unlike methods that use hand-placed waypoints.
summary: NeRF-based Trajectory Optimization plans robot paths by optimizing dense waypoints via gradient descent, using NeRF density for implicit obstacle representation instead of closed-form polytopes.
